heard.quote: My associates already auto-blast messages tailored to each client. Is this not the same thing?
heard.answer: No. A blast is one message to many people, and when a buyer replies nobody is there to answer. 41 Closer replies to one buyer about one listing and asks the next question until a viewing is booked or the buyer says no. If all you want is to send a broadcast, a WhatsApp broadcast list or a blast tool is cheaper and you should use that instead.

heard.quote: I follow up with voice notes. It is more personal than a typed reply.
heard.answer: Keep doing that. The agent does not send voice notes and does not make calls, it types. It gets the buyer to the point where your voice note is worth sending, with the qualifying questions already answered. You send the voice note to a buyer with a viewing booked, not to one who asked what floor and vanished.

heard.quote: My associate tried an AI tool and the summary it gave was not exact.
heard.answer: That happens when a tool is left to guess. 41 Closer answers only from the listing sheet you give it, and when a question is outside the sheet it says it will check and hands the chat to the agent. You see every handover with the full conversation. It can still get something wrong, which is one more reason price and offers are kept away from it.

heard.quote: I already pay S$9,000 a month for a marketing team plus ads. I cannot add a cost before the commission comes in.
heard.answer: Then look at what happens to the enquiries you already pay for. That agent had 35 enquiries land in the month before one launch, and 41 Closer does not make more enquiries, it answers the ones you have. If your problem is too few leads, spend on ads, this is not it. If the problem is leads landing and going cold, this is it, at S$690 a month with no contract.

heard.quote: CEA will not let a bot negotiate for me.
heard.answer: Correct, and it does not. The agent answers listing facts, asks your qualifying questions, books the viewing and chases. The moment a buyer asks whether the owner can negotiate, or a seller asks what their flat is worth, it says that is for the agent and hands over the chat. Your registered salesperson does every part of the job that needs a licence.

heard.quote: I have a few listings and I reply fast myself.
heard.answer: Then do not buy this. One agent with a handful of listings who replies within minutes loses nothing to a slow reply. This is for a team leader whose agents each carry listings and ad spend and cannot be on their phones at every viewing.

faq: Our agents get lots of enquiries about property listings. What should we do with them?

Answer each one within minutes, ask the qualifying questions before anyone calls, and book the viewing in the same chat. That is what 41 Closer does on your team's WhatsApp number. Your agents then spend their time on buyers who have a budget, a slot and a reason to move. The buyer who asked what floor at 11pm gets an answer at 11pm instead of the next afternoon.
Can an AI answer property enquiries on WhatsApp without breaking CEA rules?

Yes, as long as it stays on listing facts and bookings. 41 Closer answers availability, floor, size, asking price, psf and agent fee from the sheet you give it. It does not negotiate, does not give an opinion on value and does not advise on an offer. Those stay with your registered salesperson, and the agent hands the chat over the moment a buyer or seller asks.
What does it say when a buyer asks if the owner can nego?

It says it does not discuss price and that the agent will speak to them directly. Then it offers a viewing slot so the buyer sees the unit first. The agent gets the chat with the buyer's budget and ownership status already filled in. Nothing about price is said until a licensed person says it.
Does it work for new launches as well as resale listings?

Yes. For a launch you give it the project facts, unit types, the preview and launch dates and how you want interest registered. It registers the buyer, asks your qualifying questions and books the showflat visit or the call. The new-launch agent we spoke to had 35 enquiries land in the month before one launch, which is the month they most need answering.
Does it run on one team number or on each agent's number?

It runs on one WhatsApp Business number. Most teams put it on the number their listings and ads point to, and it hands each buyer to the agent who owns that listing with the full chat. If every agent needs it on their own number, ask us first and we will tell you honestly whether that fits.
Can it book the viewing straight into my agent's calendar?

On Starter it sends your calendar link and confirms the slot the buyer picks. On Pro it books the viewing or the call straight into the listing agent's calendar and writes the buyer into your CRM. Connecting a system we have connected before is a one-time S$2,400.
How much does an AI agent for a property team cost in Singapore?

Starter is S$690 a month and Pro is S$1,490 a month. The build is included and there is no setup fee. You pay for one month from the day it goes live, then month to month with 30 days notice and no contract. No GST is charged. We build your agent first, you message it, then one free hour to walk through the platform and connect your WhatsApp before any money moves.
Can it reply in Chinese or Malay?

It replies in English and in the mixed English that Singapore buyers type. If a large share of your buyers write in Chinese or Malay, ask us before counting on it. We will tell you what we have tested rather than promise it.
